summary: Reply previews in Flutter and web now open their target even when it is outside the currently loaded history page. Loaded targets scroll into view; unloaded targets use the existing bounded message-context endpoint and provide a return path.

checks.name: TEXT unloaded reply target regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'opens a reply context when its target is outside loaded history'
checks.observation: A test-first regression reproduced failure to open an older target; after the change, tapping the reply opens the context page centered on the target.

checks.name: DM unloaded reply target regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'opens a DM reply context when its target is outside loaded history'
checks.observation: The DM reply preview opens its target via the DM history-at endpoint when that message is not loaded.

checks.name: Full Flutter suite and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test && flutter analyze
checks.observation: All 336 Flutter tests passed and the analyzer reported no issues.

checks.name: Frontend tests and production build
checks.command: cd frontend && npm test && npm run build
checks.observation: 233 test files / 710 tests passed and the Vite production build completed; Vite emitted its existing large-chunk advisory.

checks.name: Desktop and Android debug compilation
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter build macos --debug --no-pub && flutter build apk --debug --no-pub
checks.observation: macOS Debug app and Android Debug APK compiled successfully.

limitations: No ADB/device runtime acceptance was performed.
Windows compilation/runtime and live backend navigation/read-cursor acceptance remain unverified.
remaining: Verify reply navigation with live backend data across cursor-page boundaries and confirm read-cursor behavior on supported runtime platforms.
